title: G3: base, tall and overhead cabinet variants from one core
body:
## Objective
Implement **G3 — three cabinet variants** per `VanDesign_V5_System_Architecture.md`, section 12: **base unit, tall cabinet, and overhead cupboard from one CAD-neutral assembly generator**, not three copied scripts. G4 is the **subsequent change/regeneration engine**, not part of G3.

## Verified baseline (preserve unchanged)
- Branch `feature/v5-fusion-adapter`, draft PR #3, completed Fusion smoke-test issue #2.
- Fusion v2705.1.30, named design `v5-smoke-test`: A–E user-run reports **PASS 58/58 each**, parameter edits and reported save/reopen.
- Separate real-Fusion cut audit: `dado.shelf1.left` cuts only `panel.left.001`; `dado.shelf1.right` cuts only `panel.right.001`; timeline restored. [Evidence](https://github.com/AnyBuzzin/van-design-system/blob/feature/v5-fusion-adapter/prototypes/claude-v5/docs/test-results/cut_audit_20261014_174320_047406.txt).
- Working V4 exact final source provenance remains issue #1, unresolved.

## G3 engineering contract
1. Add versioned, typed **variant/preset specifications**, with clearly documented illustrative dimensions. Preserve current `CabinetSpec` default, current `base_cabinet@1` schema compatibility, names/formulas, and A–E regressions. Decide explicitly how schema evolution works; no breaking reinterpretation.
2. Keep `build_cabinet(spec) -> AssemblyDefinition` or a deliberate equivalent **single authoritative generator** for panels/operations. No duplicated calculations by variant; no `adsk` in core.
3. Make a reproducible new, empty Fusion design for each of base, tall and overhead variants. G3 does **not** imply 3 cabinets coexisting in one design: the current adapter rejects nonempty root, and `Cab_*` parameter names are global. Multi-instance scoping belongs to later work.
4. Preserve stable IDs, explicit one-target `participantBodies`, shelf unmodified guarantees, real geometry checks and fail-closed PASS/FAIL/UNKNOWN reporting. Support variants with differing shelf/door counts without assuming the default case's 58-check total.
5. Add pure-Python regression tests, malformed/unsafe-spec tests, schema-roundtrip tests and report fixture coverage; run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` for prototype and foundation, Python 3.10/3.12 CI. Record expected measured dimensions derived from canonical formulas.
6. Provide a user-readable 3-variant Fusion test procedure: three **separate** saved designs, correct cut-target audit for each with grooves, no unexpected interference, no duplicate managed entities after rerun, save/reopen checks. All required checks must PASS with recorded reports before G3 is complete.
7. Keep the G2 branch and V4 files immutable in functionality. Develop on a child branch; do not merge draft PR #3 to `develop` without code review and reconciliation with `src/vandesign`.

## Explicitly out of scope
G4 incremental structural regeneration; safe reconciliation of manual Fusion edits; multi-cabinet placement/coordinate system; verified hanging/mounting structure or loads for an overhead cupboard; vehicle fitment; CNC/CAM/manufacturing certification; AI layout generation.

## Code-review notes for Claude
- Prototype lives in `prototypes/claude-v5/VanCabinetJoineryV5/vandesign`, while a separate foundation package exists at `src/vandesign`. Plan the integration, avoid duplicate business rules; do not perform an unsafe wholesale move as part of G3.
- Current schema restricts `module` to `base_cabinet@1`, defaults to one shelf/two doors, and models nominal `ply_mm` only.
- Current `FusionAdapter.compile` refuses a nonempty root and creates global `Cab_*` user parameters.
- Runner stores initial spec; live parameter edits appear in `parameters_read_from_fusion`, not as a rewritten stored spec. Do not misrepresent this as complete bidirectional regeneration.
- Offline original 30/30 tests rerun 2026-10-14; prototype CI (with mocked report test) last observed successful on PR. Fusion smoke evidence is broader and authoritative for the tested fixture only.

## Exit criteria
3 different variant specs go through the SAME generator and Fusion adapter; each has a user-supplied real-Fusion PASS report for an initial build and after save/reopen; geometric/probe/cut ownership evidence recorded; old A–E regression remains green; all evidence and deviations documented. This issue is **open** until actual Fusion G3 tests.
